description: The Korean Today's daily indicator set from public sources, each value with day-on-day change, its own date and its position in the last 30 days (0 = 30-day low, 1 = 30-day high): KRW base rates for USD, JPY (per 100), EUR, CNY (Export-Import Bank of Korea); national gasoline, diesel and LPG prices (Opinet); Seoul forecast high/low and fine-dust grade (KMA, Air Korea); stock-exchange closures and public holidays today; and a 10-item grocery basket of national retail averages with year-ago prices (KAMIS: rice, napa cabbage, radish, onion, garlic, green onion, potato, apple, mackerel, milk). No combined score. Crypto and international metals on the page are not returned. Recomputed around 09:00 KST — check is_past.

group.description: One group: fx, fuel, weather, trading or grocery. Omit for all.
